## 9849988fda31

**Finding: reproduced request-contract defect.** Generator SHA-256
`ed20e08201dd666082452f39c84f8383266c3c79e0c0830447f774fd2545e135` accepts
invalid scalar controls instead of rejecting them. The source-bound probe
accepted 5/5 representative invalid calls: boolean and floating-point seeds,
negative and string sample indices, and an unknown difficulty string. Each call
returned a normal-looking 2×W training grid.

Reproduction: `checks/audit/9849988fda31/probe.py` and
`checks/audit/9849988fda31/probe.json`. This does not show wrong labels for valid
calls, but it permits malformed request metadata to enter deterministic data
pipelines and can silently collapse or misclassify lesson identities. No repair
was made because this is an audit-only target. An optional shared defect-lint
attempt was interrupted and is not relied upon for this conclusion.
